text:
maria_ae: FYI CampusFlow reached out — they're running a constrained-budget campus pilot with a research lab + student projects. Asking for a 6-month extended trial (starts now) and an elevated startup grant. They also want preferential overage pricing after a phased ramp. Any quick rules for exceptions?

tom_se: quick tech notes: they want hashed logs only, KMS-managed keys, and a VPC-connected test environment for a short on-prem evaluation. Contact is @prof_hoskins. We'll need to size the infra if we go VPC.

jordan_dealdesk: what numbers are they requesting for credits/discounts? Standard policy: startup grant = 50k tokens, anything >100k needs DealDesk + finance OK.

maria_ae: they asked for 120k up front, then a commit schedule: months 1-2: 150k/mo, months 3-6: 800k/mo. Proposal from my side: 120k grant + 3mo minimum commit at 200k/mo then option to scale with a pre-agreed cap. Overage ask: 25% off published rate, and rollover allowed only once into month 4.

opsbot: auto: "Promo threshold: >100k token grants require DealDesk ticket and legal review of non-standard SOW clauses."

jordan_dealdesk: ok, two things we need: (1) a USD exposure estimate so finance can clear the promo, (2) legal to see the KMS + data handling wording. If finance approves exposure and legal signs off, DealDesk can approve a one-time grant of up to 120k with conditional discount.

sam_cs: if we give 120k grant we'll want a simple onboarding/milestone plan: attach a 6-week prompt-eval checklist, weekly sync for first 8 weeks, and a guardrail to suspend tokens if detected abuse. I'll draft a template.

finance_kate: for finance: if we commit to a discounted overage we need either a min USD commitment or a short-term recoup mechanism. Provide me ballpark token -> USD at public rate and the proposed 25% off so I can model exposure.

legal_amy: I'll review KMS/IP/data handling. Quick ask: do they want an IP assignment clause or just a carveout for university projects? Also be explicit on telemetry — hashed vs suppressed identifiers.

tom_se: also note grading spikes — they expect periodic surges (midterms/finals) up to 2x baseline for a few days. Suggest we set a short-term burst allowance that is billable at overage but within a safety cap.

maria_ae: proposed final terms for approval: 
```
- Trial grant: 120,000 free tokens upfront (one-time)
- Minimum commitment: 200k tokens/month for months 1-3, optional scale to 800k tokens/month for months 4-6 if customer elects
- Overage: bill at public rate minus 25%; emergency burst allowance up to 2x baseline for up to 5 days/month, billed at capped overage (max 2x baseline charge)
- Rollover: unused tokens from months 1-3 can roll once into month 4 only
- Security: KMS-managed keys, hashed telemetry, SOC2 attestation timeline to be included in SOW
- Success obligations: weekly check-ins for first 8 weeks + prompt-eval suite
```

jordan_dealdesk: I'll open a DealDesk ticket and flag for finance/legal. Tentative +1 if finance signs off on exposure and legal approves the SOW language. Also require a one-line anti-abuse clause in SOW.

opsbot: DealDesk ticket created: DD-2026-4901.

finance_kate: can someone drop a quick calc? At public rate that exposure is roughly $0.000012 per token (example), so 800k tokens/mo ~ $9.60k/mo before discounts. I'll run precise numbers once you confirm the public rate and exact months.

legal_amy: will review and aim to get back within 48 hours. Please cc contract@redwood when you have the SOW draft.

sam_cs: drafting milestone template now, will drop in shared drive and post link here by EOD.

maria_ae: thanks all. If DealDesk approves the grant I'll request a temporary promo code and share the SOW addendum with the customer. Planning demo with Prof Hoskins next Tue. :thumbsup:

jordan_dealdesk: marking this thread for follow-up. DM me if you need a fast promo code before legal signs off. :white_check_mark:

maria_ae: noted. I'll add Prof Hoskins' SOC2 timeline and the research lab MOU to the ticket.
